BatchItem.description: One flat shape for both item kinds; `type` ("track" | "identify") selects which fields and rules apply.

BatchItemResult.description: Exactly one of EventId (accepted) or Errors (rejected) is present.

ProfileListItem.description: Search row: no attributes — that document is uncapped and belongs to the detail endpoint (ruling F7).

SegmentListItem.description:
Row of GET /segments — the columns covered by `IX_Segments_TenantId_CreatedAt_Id` (H11) plus
            `Id`/`CreatedAt`; no `description` or `definition` here (detail-only, ruling H2/F7 idiom).

SegmentResponse.description:
JsonElement SegmentResponse.Definition is always the canonical form (`CanonicalRuleWriter.Write`).
        int? SegmentResponse.RealtimeMemberCount is always null in this plan (H2); it arrives with the real-time plan.

SegmentWriteRequest.description:
Body of POST /segments and PUT /segments/{id} (task 5 brief, JSON camelCase). JsonElement SegmentWriteRequest.Definition
            is a raw JsonElement so `RuleParser` validates it; a missing or JSON-null "definition"
            property deserializes to `default(JsonElement)` (ValueKind Undefined), which the rule parser itself
            rejects at path "definition" — no separate null check is needed.

TrackRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/track. Everything is nullable so a missing field reaches the validator instead of failing deserialization.

bearer.description: Dashboard users: 15-minute access token from POST /v1/auth/login.
